hints.title: Prioritize Shared Type 3 Edges
hints.text: Type 3 edges can be traversed by both Alice and Bob. Greedily add Type 3 edges first to provide connectivity to both simultaneously.

hints.title: Individual Edge Processing
hints.text: Next, process Type 1 edges into Alices disjoint set union, and Type 2 edges into Bobs disjoint set union.

hints.title: Redundant Edge Accounting
hints.text: An edge is redundant if its endpoints are already in the same connected component. Return redundant count if both graphs become fully connected, else -1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Combinatorial subset testing of edges is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual DSU with priority on type 3 edges runs in near-linear O(E * alpha(V)) time and O(V) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves that prioritizing shared edges maximizes total edge removals while maintaining twin connectivity.
